description: A React component for previewing PDF files, including rendering pages, handling scroll events, and managing PDF document loading.

classes.name: PDFPreview
classes.description: A React component class for rendering PDF previews with page rendering, scroll handling, and PDF document management.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles file download by redirecting to the file's download URL.

methods.name: isInViewport
methods.description: Checks if a given page element is within the current viewport.

methods.name: renderPDFPage
methods.description: Renders a specific PDF page onto its canvas if in viewport and not already rendered.

methods.name: getPdfDocument
methods.description: Loads the PDF document from the specified URL.

methods.name: onDocumentLoad
methods.description: Handles successful PDF document load, initializing page canvases.

methods.name: onDocumentLoadError
methods.description: Handles errors during PDF document loading.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of the PDF document, caching the result.

methods.name: handleScroll
methods.description: Debounced handler for scroll events to trigger page rendering.
